prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Fenhollow: peat fen, pale pools and an old archaeological dig under a soft grey sky. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 1 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
